name: finalnotes-readonly
description: Lets Claude search and read your exported meeting notes. Read-only, limited to the FinalNotes folder.
long_description: Runs the official MCP filesystem server (@modelcontextprotocol/server-filesystem) on your FinalNotes folder and passes through only its read tools. Writing, editing, moving and creating files is refused, and the folder cannot be widened through MCP roots.

tools.name: read_multiple_files
tools.description: Read several meeting files at once

tools.name: read_media_file
tools.description: Read an image or audio file

tools.name: read_file
tools.description: Read a meeting file (older name of read_text_file)

notes_folder.title: FinalNotes folder
notes_folder.description: The folder the Meeting Notes app exports to (Settings > General > FinalNotes export).
